KŌMA Studio

URL: https://koma-studio.site
Repository: https://github.com/klaus-2/koma-studio
License: MIT (https://github.com/klaus-2/koma-studio/blob/main/LICENSE)
Chat: https://chat.koma-studio.site
Discord: https://discord.gg/tzaV2efD4e

Summary:
KŌMA Studio is free and open-source (MIT) scanlation software for manga, manhwa, and comics.
It is a self-hostable desktop app covering translation, cleanup, redraw, typesetting, QA,
and chapter-scale production workflows. There is no paid tier, no credit system, and no
usage telemetry. Users bring their own AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or a local
OpenAI-compatible model).
